description: Planify downloads the file and returns media_urls to pass to planify_create_post. Use this when the image already exists at a public URL — the usual case after generating one. The URL must be publicly reachable; private and internal addresses are refused.

urls.description: One or more publicly reachable http(s) URLs.

name: planify_upload_media_from_url
title: Planify: add an image or video from a URL
